metadata.title: Selective Color Portrait with Distressed Display Type

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome close-up portrait featuring selective color in the eyes and vibrant, distressed display typography in the lower corner.
triggerTerms: monochrome face with orange grunge text
high contrast black and white male portrait with tribal tattoo

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered headshot of a man with textured hair and stubble, rendered in desaturated black and white except for striking blue irises. The background is a solid deep black, and a bold, orange, distressed title sits in the bottom right corner paired with clean secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the pale skin tones and the absolute black background.
Selective color pop of the blue eyes against the monochrome face.
Juxtaposition of rough, hand-drawn display type with clean, geometric sans-serif metadata.
Visual weight balanced by the subject's face and the bottom-right typographic cluster.
coreInvariants: Distressed, painterly texture on the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the selective blue color.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the blue eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the mouth, then drops to the orange typography in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounding the head and shoulders, focusing all attention on the facial features.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white monochrome for the subject and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the face; high saturation contrast in the eyes and text against the desaturated subject.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical strokes feature downward drips or splatters
Rough, eroded edges suggesting a dry-brush or stencil effect
Variable baseline and height for a chaotic, energetic feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'P' have elongated, jagged descenders
Inner counters are small and irregularly shaped
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a chaotic, textured display face and a calm, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the distressed, aggressive brush stroke energy of the display text.
Provides the clean, wide-tracked geometric contrast for the metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white close-up portrait of a man with textured hair and stubble against a pure black background. The eyes must be a vibrant, saturated electric blue while the rest of the image remains monochrome.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, distressed orange title in a grunge brush style in the bottom right corner. Below it, add a secondary line of text in a clean, wide-tracked white geometric sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Are the eyes the only colored part of the subject?
Does the orange text have a distressed, painterly texture?
Is the secondary text widely tracked and clean?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue eye color
Level of distress/drip on the typography
Amount of stubble/texture on the face
Tracking width of the secondary text
mustRedesign: Specific facial identity of the subject
Exact shape of the tribal tattoo

mustAchieve: Deep, true blacks in the background
Legible but highly textured display type
avoid: Generic, clean sans-serif for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue eyes do not look unnatural or glow excessively.
Verify the orange text is vibrant and stands out against the black/white shoulder area.
Check that the secondary text is perfectly aligned under the primary title.
Confirm the high-contrast lighting preserves facial detail without blowing out highlights.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Monochrome Portrait] + [Selective Color Eyes] + [Distressed Brush Typography] + [Geometric Sans-Serif Subtext] over [Solid Black Background].
